mc_sequential_mean — CONVERGE montecarlo op

• 数据种类:无 → table(仅由参数决定的算子 —— 不接受图像或数据输入)

• 调用: import fullseye as fs; fs.ledger.mc_sequential_mean(sampler='pi', tol=0.01, rel_tol=0.0, confidence=0.95, batch=4096, max_samples=4000000, seed=0, on_fail='raise', history_stride=1) -> 'dict'(要直接调用实现,import converge; converge.mc_sequential_mean(sampler='pi', tol=0.01, rel_tol=0.0, confidence=0.95, batch=4096, max_samples=4000000, seed=0, on_fail='raise', history_stride=1) -> 'dict';从台账取用则 opsconverge.get("mc_sequential_mean"))

• GPU:无(仅 CPU 参考实现)

用法

序贯蒙特卡罗均值：不断加样本，直到置信区间窄于容许值。

> 以下的详细说明为原文 —— 摘要与标题已翻译。

sampler(rng, n) returns n i.i.d. samples (a 1-D array) — or the built-in "pi" (4 * [u^2 + v^2 <= 1], mean pi). Batch b is drawn from default_rng((seed, b)), so the result is reproducible and does not depend on how many batches came before.

Stops at the first batch boundary, from the second batch on, where the half-width z * s / sqrt(n) <= tol + rel_tol * |mean| (z from confidence; s the running sample standard deviation). This is the fixed-width sequential interval of Chow & Robbins 1965; never stopping inside the first two batches guards against an early, accidentally small variance (raise batch to guard more) — the actual coverage is checked by the gates, not assumed.

Returns mean, se, ci (lower, upper), half_width, n_samples (used), converged and history (n, mean, se per batch). Refusal: max_samples reached first raises NotConvergedError (on_fail="record" returns the record with mean = None and the running values under last_mean / last_se).
